html:
With Vietlook Travel, visit Quang Phu Cau Incense Village, located right on the outskirts of Hanoi, one of the hundreds of years old craft villages. Currently, Quang Phu Cau Incense Village is an attractive destination for tourists from all over the world to visit and check in, with colorful bundles of incense arranged in many different shapes, or colorful flowers.

From the capital Hanoi, visitors to Quang Phu Cau Incense Village only need to spend half a day to enjoy visiting and taking pictures, or experience the way of making incense with the locals here, which will bring visitors a feeling of excitement.

Although half a day is not quite long, it is enough for visitors to visit and check in next to the scenery of Quang Phu Cau Incense Village.

Detailed schedule for a half-day tour of Quang Phu Cau Village

8:00: Pick up guests at the hotel or Hanoi Opera House, depart to visit Quang Phu Cau Incense Village.

9:15- 9:30: Arrive at Quang Phu Cau village, visitors walk around the incense village, watch local people make incense through the stages of cutting bamboo, dipping sticks in dye, creating incense powder and drying incense under the sun… visitors can interact with local people to learn about the history of incense making in the village. Visitors are free to walk around the village to take pictures of incense bundles, the incense making process, with incense bundles arranged in the shape of flowers, different images that look very eye-catching…

11:00: The car takes visitors back to Hanoi, arriving at the original pick-up point around 12:15. End of the 1/2 day Quang Phu Cau Incense Village tour, see you again in the next journey with Vietlook Travel.
